# `/sod-policies` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /sod-policies/v1

`createSodPolicyV1` — Create sod policy

This creates both General and Conflicting Access Based policy, with a limit of 50 entitlements for each (left & right) criteria for Conflicting Access Based SOD policy. Requires role of ORG_ADMIN.

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_POLICY_ADMIN
- Body (application/json): sodpolicy
- Returns 201: sodpolicy

### GET /sod-policies/v1

`listSodPoliciesV1` — List sod policies

This gets list of all SOD policies. Requires role of ORG_ADMIN

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage, idn:sod-policy:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_POLICY_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
  - `filters` (query) — fields: id: eq, in; name: eq, in, sw, co; state: eq, in; level: eq, in; type: eq; description: eq, co, sw; ownerRef.name: eq, sw — e.g. `id eq "bc693f07e7b645539626c25954c58554"`
  - `sorters` (query) — fields: id, name, created, modified, description, ownerRef.name — e.g. `id,name`
- Returns 200: array of sodpolicy

### GET /sod-policies/v1/{id}

`getSodPolicyV1` — Get sod policy by id

This gets specified SOD policy. Requires role of ORG_ADMIN.

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage, idn:sod-policy:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_POLICY_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the SOD Policy to retrieve.
- Returns 200: sodpolicy

### PUT /sod-policies/v1/{id}

`putSodPolicyV1` — Update sod policy by id

This updates a specified SOD policy. Requires role of ORG_ADMIN.

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_POLICY_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the SOD policy to update.
- Body (application/json): sodpolicy
- Returns 200: sodpolicy

### DELETE /sod-policies/v1/{id}

`deleteSodPolicyV1` — Delete sod policy by id

This deletes a specified SOD policy. Requires role of ORG_ADMIN.

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_POLICY_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the SOD Policy to delete.
  - `logical` (query) — default True — Indicates whether this is a soft delete (logical true) or a hard delete. Soft delete marks the policy as deleted and just save it with this status. It could be fully deleted or recovered further.…
- Returns 204: no body

### PATCH /sod-policies/v1/{id}

`patchSodPolicyV1` — Patch sod policy by id

Allows updating SOD Policy fields other than ["id","created","creatorId","policyQuery","type"] using the [JSON Patch](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902) standard. Requires role of ORG_ADMIN. This endpoint can only patch CONFLICTING_ACCESS_BASED type policies. Do not use this endpoint to patch general policies - doing so will build an API exception.

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOD_POLICY_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the SOD policy being modified.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: sodpolicy

### POST /sod-policies/v1/{id}/evaluate

`startEvaluateSodPolicyV1` — Evaluate one policy by id

Runs the scheduled report for the policy retrieved by passed policy ID. The report schedule is fetched from the policy retrieved by ID.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The SOD policy ID to run.
- Returns 200: reportresultreference

### GET /sod-policies/v1/{id}/schedule

`getSodPolicyScheduleV1` — Get sod policy schedule

This endpoint gets a specified SOD policy's schedule.

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage, idn:sod-policy:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the SOD policy schedule to retrieve.
- Returns 200: sodpolicyschedule

### PUT /sod-policies/v1/{id}/schedule

`putPolicyScheduleV1` — Update sod policy schedule

This updates schedule for a specified SOD policy.

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the SOD policy to update its schedule.
- Body (application/json): sodpolicyschedule
- Returns 200: sodpolicyschedule

### DELETE /sod-policies/v1/{id}/schedule

`deleteSodPolicyScheduleV1` — Delete sod policy schedule

This deletes schedule for a specified SOD policy by ID.

- Scopes: idn:sod-policy:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the SOD policy the schedule must be deleted for.
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /sod-policies/v1/{id}/violation-report/run

`startSodPolicyV1` — Runs sod policy violation report

This invokes processing of violation report for given SOD policy. If the policy reports more than 5000 violations, the report returns with violation limit exceeded message.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The SOD policy ID to run.
- Returns 200: reportresultreference

### GET /sod-policies/v1/{id}/violation-report

`getSodViolationReportStatusV1` — Get sod violation report status

This gets the status for a violation report run task that has already been invoked.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage, idn:sod-violation:read
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — The ID of the violation report to retrieve status for.
- Returns 200: reportresultreference

### GET /sod-policies/v1/sod-violation-report-status/{reportResultId}

`getSodViolationReportRunStatusV1` — Get violation report run status

This gets the status for a violation report run task that has already been invoked.

- Scopes: idn:sod-violation:manage, idn:sod-violation:read
- Parameters:
  - `reportResultId` (path, required) — The ID of the report reference to retrieve.
- Returns 200: reportresultreference
